correctness.rationale: The two unary recurrences trace a specified number of steps (modulo n) in either direction, so the disjunction marks the cyclic ball. The odd cutoff is exactly its maximal size, and the even cutoff adds a closed one-step neighborhood covering the complementary consecutive arc if and only if that arc has at most three vertices. Symmetry of S handles cutoff two and universal P handles cutoff one. For n,m≥2q+1, with t moves left, maintain labels ±1,…,±t, the mark, and the remaining class, together with the atomic pebble diagram. With a stationary pebble, relations to each designated label at t−1 are fixed by its t label; match an equal or adjacent far placement by identity or the corresponding neighbor. For any other far placement, at most three choices are forbidden and the t−1 far class has n−2t+1≥4 members. When no pebble is stationary, use identical realized labels. Self-loops are absent in the large cycles; rank 1 sees the loop/unique color in C1 and only the common marked and unmarked one-types otherwise, while rank 0 sees no vertices. The submitted checker omits S(x,x) in its initial one-variable types, so those types are not literally complete at C1; this does not falsify the finding. Independent complete-atomic-diagram replay with loops (`python -B /workspace/branches/replay_records_1_3_4_5.py`, section 1) gives 1,2,5,7,9,11,13,15,17 theories through rank 8 on sizes 1–24. The unbounded result follows from the game and formulas, not the replay.
